acceptance_criteria.text: Desktop save/remove/restore with a populated RSP percentage permits ordinary Plots and Remove RSP clicks while both controls exist; no force/trial-only proof or blank-percentage shortcut.
No-comparison default geometry remains unchanged; populated and multiple/long comparison chips cannot cover Plots or Templates, and menus retain ordinary close/focus behavior.
The 390x800 narrow viewport and on-screen chart retain independent comparison/Plots targets and usable menu bounds; comparison input/add controls remain interactive.

Frontend unit tests, type check/build and required isolated application browser/regression validation pass with unchanged oracles/tolerances; exact-source branch CI and subsequent staging gate remain required.

Publish clean committed/pushed source and precise review/closure evidence under delegated technical-fix authorization; preserve all sibling code/data and leave Help policy, provider activation, deployment and broader feature acceptance untouched.
